resources.string: Capture a thought by typing or speaking, or open your planner.
Your next task with a countdown, water, and quick Capture.
Shows your current task, water and routines around the front camera.

RPM Notch draws a small black pill around the front camera with your current or next task or calendar event from your RPM plan, and water and routine reminders when you track them. Tap it to see the next few items, tick the task, snooze a reminder or log a meal. Your RPM reminders and ringing alarms show there too, with Snooze and Stop. Android only lets apps draw there through an accessibility service. RPM Notch does not read the screen, your typing or other apps. Its own taps go to RPM\'s diagnostics log only if you connected one. It hides on the lock screen and in landscape. Turn it off in RPM Settings or here at any time.
